description: This file defines a hierarchy of classes and traits for representing and computing differences between data structures, including primitives, sequences, sets, maps, and objects. It includes methods for diffing various data types and generating detailed difference reports.

classes.name: Difference
classes.description: Trait representing a generic difference with methods to produce a flattened map and a type description.

classes.name: TerminalDifference
classes.description: Trait extending Difference for terminal (leaf) differences, with a default flattened map.

classes.name: NoDifference
classes.description: Case class representing no difference, holding a value.

classes.name: TypeDifference
classes.description: Case class representing a type mismatch difference between two objects.

classes.name: PrimitiveDifference
classes.description: Case class representing a difference between primitive values.

classes.name: MissingField
classes.description: Object indicating a missing field in comparison.

classes.name: ExtraField
classes.description: Object indicating an unexpected extra field.

classes.name: OrderingDifference
classes.description: Class representing differences in sequence order patterns.

classes.name: SeqSizeDifference
classes.description: Class representing size differences in sequences.

classes.name: IndexedDifference
classes.description: Class representing differences between indexed elements of sequences.

classes.name: MapDifference
classes.description: Class representing differences between maps, including key and value differences.

classes.name: ObjectDifference
classes.description: Class representing differences between objects, based on their field maps.

methods.name: Difference.apply
methods.description: Factory method to compute the difference between two objects.

methods.name: Difference.diffSet
methods.description: Method to compute differences between two sets.

methods.name: Difference.diffSeq
methods.description: Method to compute differences between two sequences.

methods.name: Difference.diffMap
methods.description: Method to compute differences between two maps.

methods.name: Difference.diffObjectMap
methods.description: Method to compute differences between object field maps.

methods.name: Difference.diffObject
methods.description: Method to compute differences between two objects.

methods.name: Difference.isPrimitive
methods.description: Predicate to determine if a value is a primitive type.

methods.name: Difference.mkMap
methods.description: Creates a map of field names to values for an object.

methods.name: Difference.mapMaker
methods.description: Memoized function to generate a field extractor for a class.

methods.name: Difference.lift
methods.description: Converts various data types into a standardized form for comparison.
